item.title: Andy Buckner – Live Country & Southern Rock — Fri Jul 31, 9:00 PM — Shamrock Irons Irish Pub
item.description:
Expect a packed night of honkytonk, southern soul and cowboy grit from an artist creating serious buzz across North Carolina and beyond. Blending honkytonk & gritty cowboy seclusion, Country artist Andy Buckner’s music embodies a balance of party anthems, & instantly relatable heartache healers. Growing up on a Burley tobacco farm & cattle ranch deep in the Appalachian Mountains of North Carolina, Andy spent his early childhood being a ranch hand while listening to gospel, bluegrass, southern rock, & classic country music. There’s no doubt his cowboy lifestyle with horses & family rodeos, mixed with influences such as Travis Tritt, Hank Williams Jr., Waylon Jennings, Lynyrd Skynyrd, Gary Allan, Charlie Daniels, Keith Whitley, Merle Haggard, & Marty Stuart completely round out his southern soul approach. Andy’s grainy, soulful voice, embraces his North Carolina roots, & shares authentic songs inspired by his upbringing. andybuckner.com

item.title: An Evening With…. ZOSO: The Ultimate Led Zeppelin Experience — Sat Aug 1 — Pisgah Brewing Company Black Mountain
item.description:
Saturday August 1, 2026 | GATES: 6:00PM | SHOW: 7:00PM | $31.15 adv. Event Details and Tickets
Celebrating 31 years of touring in 2026, Zoso has become one of the most iconic and respected Led Zeppelin tribute experiences in the world, having played over 4,900 shows in all 50 states and internationally. Known for their unparalleled dedication to faithfully recreating the legendary band’s live performances, Zoso has earned accolades from both critics and fans alike. Zoso’s live performances focus on the raw energy and intricate musicality of Led Zeppelin’s best-known hits and deeper tracks, with a particular emphasis on recreating their live show experience. The band’s commitment to authenticity has earned them praise from major outlets, with the LA Times calling them “head and shoulders above all other Led Zeppelin tributes,” and the St. Petersburg Times describing them as “the most exacting of all the Led Zeppelin tributes.”

item.title: Fiber Friends — Sat Aug 1, 10:00 AM — 23 Ed Board
item.description:
UU Asheville Fiber Friends is a group of crafters who do handwork on personal projects and for the community. Mainly knitters and crocheters, we create warm items for donation to local charities (serving children, youth, and adults) and make a variety of cotton cloths given to Meals on Wheels for their “Santa for seniors” packages each December. A limited supply of yarn and tools (needles and hooks) are also available.
Join us the first Saturday of each month in 23 Edwin, from 10 AM until about 12 noon. For more information or to be added to the monthly email reminder list, contact Mara Sprain.
Source: Unitarian Universalist Congregation of Asheville

item.title: Mills River-BRP: Spencer Gap & Ferrin Knob 6 miles, 1225’ ascent — Wed Aug 5, 8:30 AM
item.description: The Asheville Hiking Group **Directions:** From I-26, exit 33 (Blue Ridge Parkway, Brevard Rd) : South on Brevard Rd (NC-191) for 2.4 miles to the light at the Arboretum / BRP entrance. Turn Right (West) on the BRP to trailhead **Trailhead: Bent Creek Gap**: BRP milepost 400.3 at Bent Creek Gap Rd--take the gravel road on the left to park under the overpass. Departing on time: 8:30. Look for Silver Lincoln SUV. Cell: 239-777-4743 **Details**: Hike south of the BRP from Bent Creek Gap Road into the Mills River area, and then north of the BRP over Ferrin Knob. Some rocky footing and fairly steep climbs up Trace Ridge and Ferrin Knob. Starting from BRP milepost 400.3: Walk down the National Forest Rd for 1-3/4 miles to a right on Spencer Gap trail; then up Trace Ridge trail for a short distance to the BRP.
